{{Short description|Swiss mathematician (1915–1998)}}
{{No footnotes|date=July 2025}}
'''Werner Gysin''' (15 July 1915 – 1998) was a [[Switzerland|Swiss]] mathematician who introduced the [[Gysin sequence]] and [[Gysin homomorphism]] in his only published paper {{harv|Gysin|1942}}.

Gysin obtained his [[Ph.D.]] from [[ETH Zurich]] in 1941 with a thesis written under the direction of [[Heinz Hopf]] 
and [[Eduard Stiefel]].
